lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters positioned posterior to the branchial slits, exhibiting a semi-regular spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a rectilinear grid pattern, most prominent in the region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges running parallel to the dorsal midline, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated dark-pixel silhouettes (commensal fish) attached ventrally and near the pectoral fin attachment point.
